package.description: Command-line interface for installing Unity Editors and creating, opening, and building Unity projects.

en-US.author: Unity Technologies Inc.
en-US.description: Command-line interface for installing Unity Editors and creating, opening, and building Unity projects.
en-US.longDescription: The Unity CLI (invoked as "unity") manages Unity Editor installations and modules, creates and opens projects, runs builds and Editor commands, and manages licenses and cloud sign-in from the terminal. This build reports its version as 1.0.0; MSIX package versions encode the prerelease channel in the fourth (revision) field.
en-US.name: Unity CLI
en-US.releaseNotes:
Highlights of 1.0.0 (full notes at the release notes URL):
- unity vcs uvcs review create opens a code review of a changeset or a branch, review reviewers lists who was asked to review and where each stands, and review request asks more people.
- unity vcs uvcs review lists, reads, answers and resolves code review comments on self-hosted Unity Version Control servers, through the local cm client and with no Unity sign-in (cm 11.0.16.10616 or later; listing reviews works from 11.0.16.10512).
- unity plugin install <id> installs a Unity tool published after your CLI version, and unity <id> runs it, with no CLI update.
- unity command <name> --help prints that Editor command's usage and parameters, read from the connected Editor.
- Tab completion after unity command offers the connected Editor's commands and the chosen command's parameters, in every shell and in unity shell.
- unity commands --include-editor adds the connected Editor's commands to the manifest, each marked "source": "editor".
- unity mcp --exclude-annotations <list> hides the Editor commands whose MCP annotations include any of read-only, destructive, idempotent or open-world, and refuses a call to one.
- unity mcp --exclude-tool-groups <list> hides whole Editor command groups, every command in them, and refuses a call to any of them.
